Stored versions of the SRTR data dictionary

Source: R/dictionary_versions.R
dictionary_versions.Rd

Every version of SRTR's public SAF data dictionary page that sRtr has stored, kept as runs: each variable or format code appears once for each unbroken sequence of stored versions in which it was the same. Use srtr_dictionary() to get the dictionary for a release; this dataset is what it reads.

Format

A list of three tibbles:

releases

One row per stored snapshot: snapshot, release, revision, title, sha256, encoding, last_modified, retrieved and source.

dictionary

Variables: Dataset, Variable, Type, Length, FormatID, Label, and first and last, the first and last snapshots of the run.

formats

Format codes: Format, Code, Meaning, Position (the code's place within its format), first and last.

Source

SRTR SAF data dictionary pages, stored in data-raw/dictionary-versions/.

Details

Versions are added by a monthly check of https://www.srtr.org/docs/datadictionary.html. A snapshot is named by the release and a revision number ("2609-1"), since SRTR can revise a page without changing its release.
